_readme: FIAT MATERIALS - Copper cable (1 Nov). Written by tools/make_copper_cable_manifest.py; the cargo icons' template. A job whose file exists is skipped.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a single salvaged material seen from above at a slight angle: a coil of thick grey-sheathed copper cable, its cut end showing bright copper strands, on a scrap of broken pallet, plain and unprinted, no markings, filling the frame. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no gun, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, no floor, wall, ground or sky around it, a plain dark neutral background.
